intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Independently choose and render a complex photographic test scene using the attached appearance reference, then evaluate whether its selected keyword components are visible. This arm uses the separately recorded agent-owned McBling gift-packing scene; no new requester definition is claimed.

In a home sewing corner beside a balcony door, one adult with the reference image's visible dark bob, fine fringe strands, soft facial outline and glossy lips organizes handmade beaded bracelets into tissue-lined gift boxes, creating a McBling mid-2000s pop-fashion gift-packing moment. The adult wears a candy-pink velour zip hoodie with a sparkling rhinestone heart motif, low-rise flared jeans and a rhinestone-studded belt; large hoop earrings catch the light, and a metallic silver shoulder bag hangs on the chair back. Seated upright on a stable chair with both feet on the floor, the adult steadies an open gift box at its near rim with the left hand while the right hand lowers one beaded bracelet onto the tissue inside it. Both forearms, wrists, fingers and the open box interior remain visible, with space between the hands. The worktable holds three already filled boxes, a shallow bead tray, loose ribbon, small fabric offcuts, and an unplugged hairdryer beside a tangled charger cable occupying the last clear patch. The completed boxes and the current partly filled box make the packing sequence readable. A shoulder-height compact-camera snapshot from the open doorway shows the adult, both working hands, the low waistline and flared denim legs in one environmental frame. Bright direct flash gives the rhinestones and silver bag crisp glints against soft daylight from the balcony; skin, velour pile, denim seams and creased tissue retain tangible photographic texture.
